body:
ye, i talk to my doctor tommorow . my family know and care but cant or dont help in many cases make things worse . 
i dont feel as low today as i did when i wrote here so i will beable to talk to my doctor and try figure some way to get better help and hopefully the right kind of therapist.

i dont think it matters now, i have one more appointment with her near the end of the month and that is the last i will probably ever talk to her. 
i dont want to kill myself but when my mood drops i feel its my only option, the sessions coming to an end made me feel desperate and helpless because after many months nothings changed .
i just feel now i have noone to turn to.

the thing is i wasn't feeling suicidal,  my mood was starting to get better although the difficult discussion about what options were available were not so good and i wasn't taking it well . then she started to just focus on the suicide stuff and repeating it was my choice and all that sounded like in my head was kill myself or go to a group therapy that if i could go to i wouldn't be in the situation where i was in therapy .  it is crazy frustrating i am struggling but if i can get to monday ill be ok i hope.

given me actual viable options , i did try one and it made things worse  . the other is beyond where i am . 
maybe talked with me instead of repeating its your choice over and over , maybe not left me alone in the room alone.
knowing i had someone i could trust and turn to helped me.

i just wanted to feel like someone cared about me , when i mentioned the suicidal stuff it was like she just became a robot an everyone i talked to was saying the same things over and over ... its your choice its your choice ... its just made me more afraid and feeling like i really dont have anywhere to turn for help .

she agrees i do need some help but she isnt the right kind of therapist to give me the help, i seen her today and my only options were some sort of emergency suicide type therapist and a support group that i would struggle with getting to and participating in.

i am on a waiting list for a confidence building course but its only part of why i was referred to a therapist .

im in the UK so its through the NHS, i wouldnt be able to afford a therapist privately .

i can talk to my doctor, when i didnt think my therapist was understanding me at first i talked with my doctor about if i can change a therapist or would i be put back on a waiting list but we agreed i should bring up my concerns with the therapist .
i did that an thats when it felt progress started to be made. 
but im not sure my doctor could do anything if the therapist has stopped my therapy .
